subject: worker
objective: Repair the first proven native Balance scoring-start effective-stat mismatch for Magmaw 10N, then verify it with the required exact-300 Balance calibration.
forbidden_changes: Do not change Balance priority policy, spell coefficients, proc formulas, gear, consumables, WoWSims requests, roster, encounter scripts, or raid route behavior.
Do not globally remove or weaken rating-from-stat behavior; scope the base-spirit correction to the Balance of Power native mechanic.
Do not accept Balance performance, actor_30001, or Magmaw 10N before the focused test, clean build, and exact-300 evidence are reviewed.
Do not alter the unrelated effective-stat fields or hide native aura/rating state from diagnostics.
acceptance_conditions: Balance of Power converts spirit gained above GetCreateStat(STAT_SPIRIT), matching the pinned WoWSims reference without changing unrelated rating-from-stat auras.
The scoring ledger reports raw combat-rating fields for comparison with WoWSims raw rating fields while retaining native effective hit/crit/haste percentage fields.
Moonkin form materializes the native 24907 Moonkin Aura when its triggered cast does not leave the passive aura applied, and form removal still removes it.

The focused source-contract regression passes, the required native build succeeds, and an identical Balance exact-300 run provides the repaired stat receipt before any actor or performance acceptance.
observations: The retained native Balance receipt reports hit_rating 1,912 versus WoWSims raw hit rating 289 and spell_hit_pct 18.664 versus 17.0041233535.
Native create spirit is 173 and published spirit is 1,623; 1,912 equals 289 plus total spirit, while the WoWSims Balance of Power implementation excludes base spirit and converts gained spirit.
The retained native spell-speed multiplier is 1.269 while WoWSims final stats contain Moonkin Aura's 1.05 multiplier and spell haste 26.8761684235.
The native shapeshift source maps FORM_MOONKIN to 24905 and 24907 through CastSpell, but the attributable scoring receipt has no 5% aura contribution in the published cast-speed field.
The comparator's raw/effective field semantics and the WoWSims ComputeStats stages make this a native stat/aura lifecycle edge, not a rotation or coefficient diagnosis.

evidence_excerpts.excerpt: The Balance observer run fails effective_stat_parity with native hit_rating 1912 versus expected 289 and spell_speed_multiplier 1.269 versus 1.3321997684; performance is unaccepted.
The exact-300 Balance run binds the native scoring-start stat snapshot and the matched fixture identity; it is the retained evidence for the first broken native edge.
Balance final pseudo stats retain raw hit rating 289, spell_hit_pct 17.0041233535, and cast-speed multiplier 1.05; the reference stages separate gained spirit from base spirit.
The routed unit requires the owner stat producer/materialization trace, one focused test, and one identical exact-300 follow-up after parity is restored.
The current graph is on master at the Balance effective-stat edge; the prior setup observer repair is closed but actor and raid performance remain open.

proposed_change: Add a Player-owned rating-from-stat helper that excludes base spirit only for Balance of Power, expose raw base combat ratings to the calibration ledger, and make Moonkin form reapply its 24907 passive when the existing triggered cast does not materialize it. Add focused source-contract and arithmetic regression coverage; preserve policy, coefficients, and all unrelated stat paths.
acceptance_claim: This plan selects a bounded native Balance mechanics repair. It does not claim that the source change, build, exact-300 run, actor performance, or Magmaw 10N acceptance has succeeded.
